description: Permanently deletes a note from Salesforce. This action cannot be undone.

note_id.description: The Salesforce ID of the note to delete.
note_id.human_parameter_description: The unique Salesforce identifier of the note you want to delete. You can copy this ID from the note’s URL or from a previous search or list action.
note_id.title: Note Id

name: delete_note

DeleteNoteResponse.description:
Response for successful note deletion.

HTTP 204 No Content - Salesforce returns empty body on successful deletion.
Error responses (4xx/5xx) are handled via raise_for_status().
DeleteNoteResponse.title: DeleteNoteResponse
